pass: Pass 21 - Settings / Healers / Access / Rankings Closure
operatorCorrections: Bare native SET options toggle their current state; explicit value forms remain only where retained native help directly documents them.
There is no inn-rest/rental system; inns are shops.
Healer-shop healing is the only required non-item purchasable service.
There is no transportation-service model; tickets/passes gate access and some room commands immediately relocate the player.
Casino and arena are native MajorMUD activities.
TOP rankings are native, including class-filtered TOP lists.
Native organizations are gangs only; gang houses are deed/upkeep based.
Worldgroup mail, account/session/login parity, weather/day-night, host limits, native logging/diagnostics, native SYSOP interface parity and crash/restart behavior are excluded.

nativeHelpEvidence.claim: TOPTEN displays the top ten adventurers.
Profile help documents Set Receive On/Off as controlling receipt of GIVE items.
Gangs: CREATE GANG requires 100000 experience; max gang name length 19; INVITE/UNINVITE; BG/BROADGANG; TOPTEN/TOP gangs; DISBAND leader-only; LEAVE GANG.

SET help documents Receive, Telepath, Follow Blind/Normal, Speech Fast/Slow and other profile settings. Some wording conflicts with operational RECEIVE polarity, so exact explicit RECEIVE/TELEPATH polarity is not over-promoted.
Practice arena PvP causes no evil points/loss of life; killed players revive in Halls Of The Dead with HP from last arena entry.
GOSSIP alone or SET GOSSIP toggles receipt; SET GOSSIP ON/OFF are explicit native forms.
AUCTION alone or SET AUCTION toggles receipt; SET AUCTION ON/OFF are explicit native forms.
BUY HEALING in the appropriate room heals all wounds for a price.

Gang houses are bought by the gang leader at the Deed Shoppe; tax is collected every sundown; insufficient funds in deed holder Silvermere bank repossess the house with its contents; guardians bar non-members; some houses contain shops/healers.
